question: Which of the following plans was introduced in the year 1945, before planned economic development began in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The People's Plan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• People's Plan was** introduced in the year 1945, before planned economic development began in India.**
 
• This plan was based on Marxist socialism and it advocated that people first must be provided with ‘basic necessities of life’.
 
• The **plan focused on agriculture and consumer goods**
 
• It emphasized the nationalization of land and production
 
• The p**lan advocated for the establishment of state-owned industrialization**
